It showed decay in one of my molars, that wasn't visible to the bare eye. When they were healing that molar, they proactively told me and took action on the adjacent tooth too, in the same session. Preventing me from so much future pain for both teeth.

He also did an implant for me ~13 years back, which has not caused even a slight problem so far.

They use top-notch tech like microscope for Root Canal, digital scanning for teeth measurement and 3D printing for the teeth model.

I have been going to them for 25 years now, it has been a personal inspiration to see them evolve from a compact area to the luxurious place they have now.

They are a great team with seamless communication, where Dr. Varun and Dr. Nikhil do the heavy-duty, intense operations while Dr. Anushree does the finesse work and completes the procedure.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Kant
featured_reviews.review_text:
For me Dr. Varun Prabhavalkar is the best maxillofacial surgeon in the world. Mine was a complicated case. He performed a surgery for the excision of an embedded canine very well.
He is also an excellent implantologist. I got 5 of my  non-usable teeth replaced by dental implants by him. He has exceptional skills and explains the procedures very well. The after implant care and fitting of crowns is also done very well by him.
His clinic, 'One Sigma Dental' is one of the best clinics I have seen. It has the latest equipment and cutting edge technology.

His wife Dr. Anushree is a great restorative dentist.
His father Dr. Ajit Prabhavalkar has been a great dentist himself and has had a flourishing dental practice for 40+ years.

Dr. Varun's team comprises of few more dentist, some doing the root canals and others attending to other aspects of dentistry.
One of his team members is Dr. Aishwarya who is also a good restorative dentist, honing her skills under the wings of Dr. Varun.

At the front office is Ms Shradhha who receives the clients very well and makes them feel at home. Shradhha also manages the after visit procedures and is always happy to answer questions regarding the follow up.

In order to get dental treatment and get dental issues solved, I travel all the way from Seattle, USA to Mumbai, in order to avail the excellent facilities and services provided by Dr. Varun Prabhavalkar and his team.
May the Lord continue to bless Dr. Varun Prabhavalkar and his team for their great work and may the team continue to flourish in all their future endeavors.
--Dr. Anjali Kant
Speech Language Pathologist
Tukwila School District
Seattle, WA, USA
